chunks: When We ordained (Solomon's) death, none but the weevil, that was eating away his staff (on which he rested), pointed out to them that he was dead. When he fell down (dead) the jinns realised that if they had knowledge of the Unknown they would never have suffered demeaning labour.
ai.seo_question: How did the Jinn discover the death of Prophet Solomon?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the distinction between Solomon’s prophetic status and the Jinn’s limited perception, illustrating that his prolonged stillness was due to divine will rather than a loss of unseen knowledge. The 'creature of the earth' (dabbat al-ard), often identified as a weevil or termite, served as the tangible sign that ended their illusion of his eternal vigilance. This event underscores the theme that even prophets are subject to death, refuting the Jinn's assumption that he possessed independent knowledge of the unseen (al-ghayb).
